narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Add the tops and add the bottoms, and you get two sixths of a kilogram.
<bookmark mark='short'/>Two sixths is less than one half, and one half is the big fish alone.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two fish together cannot weigh less than the bigger fish on its own.
